'''Fireblue Squadron''' was an [[I4 Ionizer starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the service of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance's]] [[Core Fleet]]. An elite unit, Fireblue Squadron was created to complete missions that focused on subduing and capturing enemy [[Starship/Legends|vessels]].

Formed after the Alliance [[Battle of Caamas|defeat]] at the end of the [[Sith–Imperial War]], Fireblue Squadron was frequently tasked with disabling large [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]], capturing high-value targets, and subduing civilian ships during the ensuing [[Second Imperial Civil War|Imperial Civil War]].

==History==
Fireblue Squadron was an elite [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that served the [[Core Fleet|Galactic Alliance Core Fleet]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], which began in [[130 ABY]]. [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Alliance]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] ordered the creation of the squadron after the [[Battle of Caamas|end]] of the [[Sith–Imperial War]], which saw the Alliance defeated by the [[One Sith|Sith]]-allied [[Fel Empire|Galactic Empire]]. The squadron was formed specifically to carry out missions to subdue and capture enemy [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. To complete their missions, Fireblue Squadron flew [[I4 Ionizer starfighter]]s, and the unit took its name from the intense [[blue]]-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion]] energy of the fighter's primary weapon.<ref name="LECG" />

During the civil war, the squadron was regularly tasked with disabling large [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]], allowing the Alliance to capture the ship and take its cargo. Fireblue Squadron was also deployed to capture high-value targets, as well as against civilian vessels that the Alliance did not want to destroy, but needed to disable.<ref name="LECG" />

[[File:Ionizer.jpg|thumb|right|200px|An I4 Ionizer starfighter]]

==Equipment==
To meet the squadron's main mission profile to seize and immobilize enemy ships, Fireblue Squadron utilized I4 Ionizer starfighters. The fighter carried a single [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] with an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] and was armed with multiple ion cannons, a pair of wing mounted [[disruptor torpedo]]es, and underpowered [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]. Defensively, it was well armored, but only carried light [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]] due to interference caused by the fighter's extensive ion weaponry. The [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]-capable craft were the best small fighters of the [[Time/Legends|time]] when it came to disabling ships while leaving their target's superstructure undamaged. A squadron of I4 Ionizers, such as Fireblue Squadron, was capable of immobilizing a small freighter in a single pass and larger ships with multiple attacks.<ref name="LECG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fireblue Squadron was first mentioned in the [[2009]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] sourcebook the ''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''.<ref name="LECG" />
